get.summary: Retrieve PDFs extracted on or after a specific datetime
get.description: Returns the list of PDFs and their metadata where the extraction date is greater than or equal  to the given datetime. If no datetime is provided, it defaults to 2025-05-01 00:00:00.000.

parameters.name: datetime
parameters.description: The datetime filter (format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.sss). Defaults to 2025-05-01 00:00:00.000 if not provided.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Database username (optional; defaults to environment variable)

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Database password (optional; defaults to environment variable)

200.description: A JSON array of PDF records extracted on or after the specified datetime

500.description: Internal server error, e.g., database connection issue

post.description:
Allows users to upload multiple PDF files.
The uploaded files are stored in a dynamically generated directory with the format: 
`{customer_identifier}-{bank name}-{YYYYMMDD}` inside the container `{user}`.
If `bank name` is not provided, it defaults to `"unspecified_bank"`.
If `date` is not provided, it defaults to the current date in `YYYYMMDD` format.

files.description: List of PDF files to upload

user.description: The user, which is also used as the Azure container name

customer_identifier.description: Must be a valid Unique identifier, GUID (UUID)

bank name.description: Name of the bank (defaults to `"unspecified_bank"` if not provided)

date.description: Date in `YYYYMMDD` format (defaults to today's date if not provided)

200.description: PDFs uploaded successfully

400.description: Invalid request, missing parameters or incorrect date format

500.description: Internal server error, failed to upload files

get.summary: Get transactions with merchant details for a customer
get.description:
Retrieves all transactions for a given customer, including merchant details.
If merchant extraction has not been performed, the API will trigger it before fetching transactions.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Database username (optional, uses environment variables by default).

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Database password (optional, uses environment variables by default).

200.description: A list of transactions with merchant details.

get.summary: Get paginated transactions with merchant info by customer ID
get.description:
Retrieves transactions for the specified customer ID, including merchant details, using pagination.
Default page size is 1000, but you can adjust it with query parameters.

parameters.name: customer_id
parameters.description: The customer ID to filter transactions.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Database username (optional if using default from environment).

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Database password (optional if using default from environment).

200.description: Successful response with paginated transactions.

400.description: Bad request (e.g., missing or invalid parameters).

post.description: Triggers the pipeline to rerun the assessment.

error.example: Missing required parameters: user and password

post.description:
Starts the pipeline to process PDF data for the specified customer. An optional `mode` parameter allows specifying whether to override or append to existing data (defaults to `Override`).
If a pipeline is already running for the same customer_id, this endpoint will return a 409 Conflict response.

mode.description: Optional. Determines how PDF data is processed in the pipeline.   Allowed values are `Override` (default) and `Append`.

200.description: Pipeline triggered successfully

error.example: Missing required parameters: user, password, and customer_id

409.description: A pipeline is already running for this customer_id

error.example: A pipeline is already running for customer_id '43d027ff-e6cc-4f77-ab7a-1a8f34259035'.

500.description: Pipeline trigger failed or server error

post.summary: Categorise cheque deposits as Equity Transactions or Revenue
post.description: Starts a pipeline to reclassify cheque deposit transactions, recalculate KPIs and rerun the assessment for this customer_id.

user.description: Database user, passed as container_name to the pipeline

customer_id.description: Customer ID for which cheque deposits will be recategorised

200.description: Pipeline triggered successfully

400.description: Bad request due to missing or invalid parameters

error.example: Missing required parameters user, password, customer_id, target_category

500.description: Internal server error or pipeline trigger failure

response_text.example: Pipeline trigger failed due to authentication error

post.summary: Categorise partner transactions as Equity Transactions or Transfers
post.description: Starts a pipeline to recategorize transactions based on the partner name found in the transaction description.

customer_id.description: Customer ID whose transactions will be recategorized

partner_name.description: Substring to match in transaction descriptions

target_category.description: The new category to assign to matched transactions

200.description: Pipeline triggered successfully

400.description: Bad request due to missing or invalid parameters

error.example: Missing required parameters user, password, customer_id, partner_name, target_category

500.description: Internal server error or pipeline trigger failure

response_text.example: Pipeline trigger failed due to authentication error
